evals.js: Object.assign(moire.dish.press, { on: true, depth: 0.35, period: 60 }); return 'press'

const { readBuffer } = await import('./src/snapshot.js'); const C = moire.cells, n = C.count, F = 92; const f = new Float32Array(await readBuffer(C.device, C.cellBuf, 0, n * F * 4)); let bad = 0, vmax = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n * F; i += F) { if (!Number.isFinite(f[i]) || !Number.isFinite(f[i+2])) bad++; vmax = Math.max(vmax, Math.hypot(f[i+2], f[i+3])); } return JSON.stringify({bad, vmaxR: vmax / C.R, glue: moire.glue.census})
